meta.title: Signal Harbor: Packages and Module Entitlement
meta.subtitle: Ideal state: a customer request becomes a package, a package becomes the modules one company can open

boundaries.label: Six modules: each a self-contained package of screens, routes, one agent, tools and tests

cards.title: From request to workspace
items: The customer fills in a request: company, industry, and which modules it wants
The super admin reviews it and picks the package that matches; a custom set of modules is also possible
The provisioner creates the empty company plane and writes one entitlement row per module
Nothing is installed per customer: the modules are already running, and the entitlement decides what this company can open

cards.title: Packages (names and contents are a proposal)
items: Discover: modules 1 to 3. The customer leaves with a charter, a catalogue and a gap report
Build: modules 1 to 5. Adds the build and Foresight
Run: all six. Adds the daily feed, market pulse and operations
The example on this diagram is a company on Discover

cards.title: What makes a module a package
items: A manifest: its id, screens, routes, its one agent, the tools that agent may use, and the pack sections it reads
Its inputs and its output: what it needs to start, and the document it produces
Its own tests, so a module can be released or switched off without touching the others

cards.title: Enforced in three places
items: The home page and menu show only the modules the company owns
The module gate refuses any request to a module the company does not own, whatever the screen shows
The tool registry loads only the agents and tools of owned modules, so an agent for an unowned module cannot be reached at all

cards.title: Modules that depend on each other
items: Each module starts from the output of an earlier one: the charter, the catalogue, the gap report, the build
A company that skips a module supplies that output itself: for example it uploads its own catalogue to start at module 3
Upgrading is one entitlement change; the company's earlier outputs are already in its plane

cards.title: Built today and not yet
items: Built: company creation by a super admin, an industry per company, role-based permissions on every route, a quick or enterprise mode per company
Not built: entitlements per module, the package catalogue, the request form, the module manifest, the tool registry
